# ChartKit JSON spec

> @chartkitdev/core v0.5.0 · https://chartkit.dev/schema/v1.json
> `@chartkitdev/core/all`, or `/extra` for histogram through waterfall. `validate` exports `repair`.

Pages: https://chartkit.dev/spec/<type>

## Rules

- `version` is `"1"`. `a11y.alt` is one required sentence.
- `data` is a row array, not `{ "values": [...] }`. Sparkline, mini-area, and spike may be numbers. Large data: `{ "columns": { "field": [] } }`.
- `type` is the chart. `mark` is an options object.
- Gauge, kpi, and progress-ring use `metric` (`value`, `min`, `max`, `delta`, `label`, `target`, `bands`), not top-level keys.
- Donut: `x` is the label and `y` is the value. Not `theta`, `angle`, or `label`.
- `axis` is `"y"` or `"y2"`. Titles: `axes.y.title` and `axes.y2.title`.
- Field types: `quantitative`, `temporal`, `ordinal`, `nominal`.
- Heatmap grid: `x`, `y`, `color`. Calendar: date `x` plus `color`, or `mark.layout: "calendar"`.
- Combo `y`: `[{ "field", "mark": "bar" }, { "field", "mark": "line", "axis": "y2" }]`. Not `layer`. Field lists go on `y`. `bar`, `line`, and `area` go in `mark`, not `type`.
- Extra charts (`/extra`): histogram bins `x` (`bins` default 8, `binWidth`, or `bin` count/width/sturges/sqrt/fd); `y` is a count. Boxplot `x`+`y`. Radar `x`+`y` list. Funnel `x`+`y` (bar, or trapezoid). Treemap `x`+`y`, optional `color`. Sankey `source`,`target`,`y`. Bullet `x`+`y`+`target`, `mark.ranges`. Waterfall `x`+`y`; `mark.total` is an absolute bar.

## Repair

`repair(spec)` applies each `fix` and returns `{ spec, ok, errors, applied }`. It does not mutate the input. Render when `ok`.

## line

```json
{"version":"1","type":"line","data":[{"quarter":"Q1","units":40},{"quarter":"Q2","units":55}],"encoding":{"x":"quarter","y":"units"},"a11y":{"alt":"Units rose in Q2."}}
```

## bar

```json
{"version":"1","type":"bar","data":[{"lane":"A","stops":12},{"lane":"C","stops":15}],"encoding":{"x":"lane","y":"stops"},"a11y":{"alt":"Lane C has more."}}
```

## donut

```json
{"version":"1","type":"donut","data":[{"wood":"Oak","boards":8},{"wood":"Pine","boards":5}],"encoding":{"x":"wood","y":"boards"},"a11y":{"alt":"Oak is the larger share."}}
```

## stacked-area

```json
{"version":"1","type":"stacked-area","data":[{"year":"2022","rail":20,"road":30},{"year":"2023","rail":24,"road":28}],"encoding":{"x":"year","y":["rail","road"]},"a11y":{"alt":"Road stayed larger."}}
```

## scatter

```json
{"version":"1","type":"scatter","data":[{"temp":16,"yieldKg":3},{"temp":22,"yieldKg":5}],"encoding":{"x":"temp","y":"yieldKg"},"a11y":{"alt":"Yield is higher at 22."}}
```

## combo

```json
{"version":"1","type":"combo","data":[{"week":"W1","orders":30,"rate":0.4},{"week":"W2","orders":36,"rate":0.55}],"encoding":{"x":"week","y":[{"field":"orders","mark":"bar"},{"field":"rate","mark":"line","axis":"y2"}]},"axes":{"y2":{"title":"Fill rate"}},"a11y":{"alt":"Orders and fill rate rose."}}
```

## heatmap

```json
{"version":"1","type":"heatmap","data":[{"bin":"A","band":"Low","level":1},{"bin":"B","band":"Low","level":4}],"encoding":{"x":"bin","y":"band","color":"level"},"a11y":{"alt":"Bin B is darker."}}
```

## gauge

```json
{"version":"1","type":"gauge","metric":{"label":"Capacity","value":64,"min":0,"max":100},"a11y":{"alt":"Capacity is 64 of 100."}}
```

## kpi

```json
{"version":"1","type":"kpi","metric":{"label":"Tickets","value":18,"delta":-0.05},"a11y":{"alt":"Tickets are 18, slightly down."}}
```

## sparkline

```json
{"version":"1","type":"sparkline","data":[4,6,5,9,8],"a11y":{"alt":"The line ends higher."}}
```

## mini-area

```json
{"version":"1","type":"mini-area","data":[2,3,3,6,5],"a11y":{"alt":"The area rises, then eases."}}
```

## progress-ring

```json
{"version":"1","type":"progress-ring","metric":{"label":"Done","value":3,"min":0,"max":8},"a11y":{"alt":"3 of 8 items are done."}}
```

## spike

```json
{"version":"1","type":"spike","data":[{"slot":"t1","hits":0},{"slot":"t2","hits":6}],"encoding":{"x":"slot","y":"hits"},"a11y":{"alt":"Hits spike at t2."}}
```

## candlestick

```json
{"version":"1","type":"candlestick","data":[{"day":"D1","open":5,"high":7,"low":4,"close":6},{"day":"D2","open":6,"high":6,"low":3,"close":4}],"encoding":{"x":"day","open":"open","high":"high","low":"low","close":"close"},"a11y":{"alt":"D2 closed down."}}
```

## histogram

```json
{"version":"1","type":"histogram","data":[{"score":1},{"score":2},{"score":2},{"score":8}],"encoding":{"x":"score"},"mark":{"bins":2},"a11y":{"alt":"Scores cluster low."}}
```

## boxplot

```json
{"version":"1","type":"boxplot","data":[{"group":"A","value":1},{"group":"A","value":3},{"group":"A","value":9},{"group":"B","value":2},{"group":"B","value":4},{"group":"B","value":5}],"encoding":{"x":"group","y":"value"},"a11y":{"alt":"Group A stretches higher."}}
```

## radar

```json
{"version":"1","type":"radar","data":[{"spoke":"Speed","car":4,"bike":2},{"spoke":"Cost","car":2,"bike":5},{"spoke":"Ease","car":3,"bike":4}],"encoding":{"x":"spoke","y":["car","bike"]},"a11y":{"alt":"The bike leads on cost and ease."}}
```

## funnel

```json
{"version":"1","type":"funnel","data":[{"stage":"Visit","count":80},{"stage":"Pay","count":12}],"encoding":{"x":"stage","y":"count"},"a11y":{"alt":"12 of 80 visits pay."}}
```

## treemap

```json
{"version":"1","type":"treemap","data":[{"name":"Oak","size":8,"group":"Wood"},{"name":"Steel","size":6,"group":"Metal"}],"encoding":{"x":"name","y":"size","color":"group"},"a11y":{"alt":"Oak is the larger tile."}}
```

## sankey

```json
{"version":"1","type":"sankey","data":[{"from":"Source","to":"Mill","flow":10},{"from":"Mill","to":"Shop","flow":6}],"encoding":{"source":"from","target":"to","y":"flow"},"a11y":{"alt":"Flow continues from the mill."}}
```

## bullet

```json
{"version":"1","type":"bullet","data":[{"name":"Revenue","value":275,"target":250,"good":300}],"encoding":{"x":"name","y":"value","target":"target"},"mark":{"ranges":["good"]},"a11y":{"alt":"Revenue is past its target."}}
```

## waterfall

```json
{"version":"1","type":"waterfall","data":[{"step":"Open","amount":120,"total":true},{"step":"Won","amount":40},{"step":"Close","amount":160,"total":true}],"encoding":{"x":"step","y":"amount"},"a11y":{"alt":"The close is 160."}}
```

## React

`<Chart spec={...} />` (React, Vue, Svelte) and `mount(el, spec)` (vanilla) render this spec. `dataKey` is not a spec key.
